description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure compliance with all regulatory standards. Join a team committed to excellence and making a significant impact on the lives of residents.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of nursing services. This includes developing and implementing nursing policies, managing departmental budgets, and overseeing staff recruitment, training, and performance. We are looking for a visionary leader who can inspire and empower our nursing professionals while maintaining the highest standards of care. This full-time position offers a competitive salary and the chance to advance your career in a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.
